proofReview.matrix: Independent contributions from original characters make letter counts sufficient. Column j of the transition matrix equals the output count vector of letter j, including two contributions from z. Thus t synchronous steps equal M^t times initial counts. Binary exponentiation and the identity for t=0 are correct, and summing the resulting vector gives length.
proofReview.independentRecurrence: For a single a, F(0)..F(25)=1. After26 steps a becomes ab, and b corresponds to a with one extra step, so F(r)=F(r-26)+F(r-25). Initial letter index c contributes F(t+c). Polynomial reduction modulo x^26-x-1 computes this recurrence without matrix multiplication.
proofReview.integerSafety: Native reference reduces after every matrix product accumulation. (MOD-1)^2+(MOD-1) fits signed64-bit. Input counts are bounded by the32MiB transport budget and are reduced before multiplication. t uses unsigned64-bit storage while the published legal domain remains nonnegative Java int. Reviewer polynomial uses arbitrary-precision integers and avoids signed32-bit overflow at t+c.
